summary: Layer 0 Open Core is stable: 48 successful analyses, fresh reputation, and Astra 10.5 with Layer 1 still gated. Collaborative evidence is thin while three overlapping field-pulse PRs (#203, #205, #206) sit open. This week is GitHub hygiene, not new architecture. Land the completed pulse with a human merge and close same-day duplicate noise.
stop: Stop opening more field-pulse PRs while #203, #205, and #206 are already open.
start: Start human-landing the completed pulse (#203) and closing same-day duplicate #205.
keep: Keep usage and reputation increments only after successful analysis, including living-PR backfill.

actions.title: Close duplicate field-pulse PR #205

steps: Comment on #205 that #206 supersedes it as the 2026-09-24 held invitation.
Do not open a replacement pulse.

actions.title: Human-land completed field-pulse PR #203

steps: Review the #203 diff for field-only pulse changes.
Human-merge #203 if the 2026-09-23 complete pulse is accurate.
Do not auto-merge and do not rotate any API keys.
actions.issueBody: PR #203 is the 2026-09-23 field pulse marked open invitation complete. A human should review and land it; do not auto-merge.

actions.title: Keep PR #206 as the sole open invitation

steps: Comment on #206 that it is the single open held invitation.
Leave #206 open until a human decides to land or close it.
File no new architecture issues; open issues is already empty.
actions.issueBody: PR #206 remains the 2026-09-24 held invitation after duplicate #205 is closed. A human decides when to land or close it.
